String.string:
[EN] You see injured crew and passengers lying about the deck.
[ES] Ves a la tripulación y pasajeros heridos tendidos por la cubierta.

[EN] The battle begins.
[ES] La batalla comienza.

[EN] Cross the bridge to the next ship.
[ES] Crucen el puente hacia el siguiente barco.

[EN] The strain of battle is tearing the ship apart.
[ES] La tensión de la batalla está destrozando el barco.

[EN] Powder Monkey has appeared.
[ES] Powder Monkey ha aparecido.

[EN] Powder Monkey has set a bomb.
[ES] Powder Monkey ha colocado una bomba.

[EN] Powder Monkey died! Mulmok becomes enraged!
[ES] ¡Powder Monkey murió! ¡Mulmok se enfurece!

[EN] Mulmok is enraged.
[ES] Mulmok está enfurecido.

[EN] The sea gives up its dead!
[ES] ¡El mar entrega a sus muertos!

[EN] Barbosa draws upon the power of noctenium.
[ES] Barbosa recurre al poder de noctenium.

[EN] Dangerous devices appear.
[ES] Aparecen dispositivos peligrosos.

[EN] Barbosa calls for his minions!
[ES] ¡Barbosa llama a sus esbirros!

[EN] Eliminate all Unstable Sorcerers to remove Barbosa's invincibility.
[ES] Elimina a todos los Unstable Sorcerers para disipar la invencibilidad de Barbosa.

[EN] Barbosa is no longer invincible.
[ES] Barbosa ya no es invencible.
